page.notes: The initial A is a large woodcut letter, transcribed as "A" joined to "Lexandri". The left margin mark "(&c" is a stray printed mark and was not transcribed as text. Marginal note texts are abbreviated and reproduced as printed where legible; "Thalestri" and "Mardos" are as printed and may contain misreadings ("Thalestris" is likely "Thalestris" with a long s).
